Ask: Executive orders requiring every grant, contract, policy, regulation, research project and enforcement action to measure effect on marriage/family, block anti-family discrimination, prefer pro-family actions
Mechanism: Series of EOs modeled on the DEI rollback
Evidence: No EO found requiring family-impact measurement across grants, contracts, rules or enforcement (absence-of-evidence from general searches of whitehouse.gov/Federal Register).

Ask: Amend EO 12866 so adverse effects on marriage/family count as 'significant' impacts triggering regulatory impact analysis
Evidence: EO 12866 was amended by EO 14215 (Feb 2025) only to extend OIRA review to independent agencies; no marriage/family 'significant' trigger found. SR323 itself cites EO 14215.

Ask: Standardized 'Family Impact Appendix' on every major rule and significant grant (Circular A-4; seven Sec. 654 factors)
Evidence: No OMB/OIRA 'Family Impact Appendix' or Circular A-4 family guidance found. Sec. 654 (1999) family-assessment statute pre-exists; no new implementing action located.

Ask: Designate a White House lead; publish a Family Formation and Social Capital Strategy with targets and a crosscut budget
Evidence: No White House family lead, Family Formation and Social Capital Strategy, or crosscut budget found. Only reported 'baby bonus' ideas and a Moms.gov launch, neither matching.

Ask: Prioritize family formation in Evidence Act learning agendas and evaluation plans
Evidence: No agency Evidence Act learning agenda found prioritizing family formation; HHS/USDA plans predate the report.

Ask: Uniform guidance for family-impact assessment in federally assisted programs; family-policy conditions on grants enforceable by DOJ (debarment)
Evidence: No OMB guidance on family-impact assessment and no DOJ-enforceable family grant conditions found.

Ask: Prefer grant applicants from communities with above-average marriage/birth rates; score commute-time effects on households with children; extend approach to every agency
Mechanism: Duffy memo (Jan 2025) cited as the model
Evidence: DOT Order 2100.7 directs preference for communities with marriage/birth rates above national average and mitigating family impacts. Commute-time scoring is Heritage's hypothetical. Not extended to other agencies. Order text itself not opened (relied on law-firm summary).

Ask: Finalize child-seating rule required by FAA Reauthorization Act of 2024; extend to other common carriers
Evidence: Congress mandated family seating (FAA Reauth Act 2024). DOT NPRM published 2024-08-09; rule listed as long-term action with no final date; Sen. Markey letter 2026-05-22 says no action for 18+ months. Not extended to other carriers.

Ask: Add marriage and family formation rates as a prioritized criterion for all economic policy
Evidence: No Treasury/Labor/Commerce action making marriage/family formation a prioritized criterion; only DOT (A07), for DOT only.

Ask: Expand relationship education/Healthy Marriage and Responsible Fatherhood programs; marriage 'bootcamp' for cohabiting parents with privately funded wedding bonus up to $5,000
Mechanism: HHS/ACF grants; churches and nonprofits deliver
Dollar_Figure: Wedding bonus up to $5,000 (private); $35M HEART precedent
Evidence: ACF awarded $100M+ to 109 organizations (HEART marriage education, FORGE fatherhood, READY4Life). Existing HMRF continued; no expansion, cohabiting-parent bootcamp, or private $5,000 wedding bonus found.

Ask: Fund pro-marriage public awareness campaigns
Evidence: No HHS-funded pro-marriage public awareness campaign found in 2025-2026.

Ask: Amend NSF Broader Impacts and NIH significance criteria to require marriage/family outcomes
Evidence: No NSF/NIH/DOE/USDA/DARPA criterion requiring marriage/family outcomes found. National Science Board recommended renaming Broader Impacts to 'societal benefits' (no family content).

Ask: Highlight curricula teaching life skills / success sequence
Evidence: No federal Dept. of Education action on success-sequence curricula found; only state laws (e.g., Ohio, Mississippi). ED grant priorities not checked directly.

Ask: Create Family and Technology Working Group in OSTP
Evidence: No OSTP Family and Technology Working Group found.

Ask: Develop AI 'family alignment' principles, testing/transparency framework, developer best practices
Evidence: No CAISI 'family alignment' framework found. White House AI legislative framework (2026-03-20) includes parental controls/age assurance but no NIST/CAISI family role.

Ask: Eliminate or sharply reduce marriage penalties across ~90 means-tested programs, holistically; claimed cost-neutral via fraud/waste cuts
Evidence: No holistic marriage-penalty reform across means-tested programs found. RSC 'Reconciliation 2.0' framework (Jan 2026) includes a CDCTC marriage-penalty fix (~$25B) but it is a proposal; whether it was introduced/passed not confirmed.

Ask: Strengthen work requirements for TANF, public housing, SNAP; close EITC loopholes
Evidence: P.L. 119-21 expanded SNAP work requirements (ABAWD age to 64) and created Medicaid work requirements (CMS IFR 2026-06-03; states comply by 2027-01-01). No TANF, public housing, or EITC-loophole action found.

Ask: Radically restructure and simplify welfare programs so benefit value is transparent
Evidence: No bill found restructuring/simplifying welfare for benefit transparency. House Ways and Means hearing (2026-09-01) on 30th anniversary of welfare reform praised P.L. 119-21 work requirements.

Ask: Eliminate fraud, waste and excess benefits, EITC singled out (14.6M single filers claimed vs 6-7M likely eligible, 2017)
Evidence: Treasury/IRS proposed regs (2026-08-19) limit the REFUNDED portion of EITC, CTC, AOTC and adoption credit to citizens, nationals and qualified aliens. Narrower than the ask (immigration eligibility, not general EITC fraud or excess benefits). Proposed only.

Ask: Cap on total stacked benefits, especially Section 8 / public housing
Evidence: No bill or action capping total stacked benefits or Section 8/public housing packages found.

Ask: FAM (Family and Marriage) credit: refundable $4,418/yr for 4 years ($17,670 total) per child of married biological parents, work requirement, 25% Large Family Bonus for 3rd+ child
Evidence: No FAM / 'Family and Marriage' credit bill found after Jan 2026 (congress.gov bill search unavailable; web search only). Only commentary on the report.

Ask: Home Childcare Equalization credit: +$2,000 per child under 5 for married FAM-eligible families
Evidence: No Home Childcare Equalization bill found. S.535 'Respect Parents' Childcare Choices Act' is a different pre-existing bill, not verified as equivalent.

Ask: NEST (Newlywed Early Starters Trust) accounts: $2,500 federal seed; tax-free withdrawal on marriage by about age 30; unclaimed funds convert to IRAs
Mechanism: New account type building on Trump Accounts
Dollar_Figure: $2,500 seed; ~$92B/10yr in text vs $83.8B in appendix
Evidence: No Newlywed Early Starters Trust bill found. Rep. Cammack's 'NEST Act' (H.R. 7422, 2026-02-11) is the Next-Generation Equity Savings Tool, a first-time homebuyer account, not the Heritage proposal (name collision).

Ask: Expand Trump Accounts (supports NEST); report treats existing $1,000 newborn deposit as baseline
Evidence: Trump Accounts enacted in P.L. 119-21 ($1,000 for births 2025-2028). Treasury app launched 2026-05-28; pilot deposits and contributions began 2026-07-04. Baseline predates SR323; no expansion found.

Ask: Remove EITC marriage penalty and small-family bias (implied by critique)
Evidence: No enacted or introduced EITC marriage-penalty fix found for 2026. P.L. 119-21 did not alter EITC structure. A CRS report on marriage penalties (2026-07-02) describes current law.

Ask: Fix adoption credit and CDCTC design biases (implied by critique)
Evidence: P.L. 119-21 made the adoption credit partly refundable (up to $5,000) and raised the CDCTC max rate from 35% to 50% (effective 2026). RSC Jan 2026 plan to change CDCTC is a proposal.

Ask: Head Start: block grants/ESAs to states (Head Start Improvement Act model), or move funds to CCDBG, or let parents use funds for at-home care
Evidence: No Head Start block-grant/ESA bill found. FY2027 White House budget and House proposal hold Head Start ~ $12.3B. A July 2025 directive barring some immigrants was enjoined. One 2026-07-27 bill reportedly expands Head Start (opposite direction; not verified).

Ask: Child credits only for households with at least one working parent; child payments only to legally responsible adults
Evidence: P.L. 119-21 requires an SSN for the CTC and sets it at $2,200 indexed; Treasury proposed regs limit refunded credits by status. No 'one working parent' rule or legally-responsible-payee rule found.

Ask: Extend FMLA leave from 12 weeks to six months for breastfeeding mothers
Evidence: No bill found extending FMLA to six months for breastfeeding mothers. Related FMLA bills found do not match.

Ask: Fully privatize Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac
Evidence: Fannie/Freddie remain in conservatorship as of late Sept 2026. Trump said in June 2026 an IPO is 'not off the table'. Only partial steps toward exit; one detail (Pulte DNI role) unconfirmed.

Ask: Stop purchasing MBS and shrink existing MBS portfolio
Evidence: Fed ended QT on 2025-12-01 and began reserve-management Treasury purchases. MBS holdings reportedly ~$1.91T on 2026-09-10, running off only gradually (secondary source).

Ask: Restore sound money; full convertibility to gold
Evidence: Only bills and commentary on speculative gold revaluation; no enacted or announced gold-convertibility action.

Ask: Eliminate rent control and stringent zoning restrictions
Evidence: Local action ran opposite in cases found: Los Angeles cut its rent-increase cap (Dec 2025), Santa Barbara adopted a rent freeze (Jan 2026). State zoning reforms exist but were not itemized. Mixed picture.

Ask: Universal savings accounts allowing at least $10,000/yr after-tax
Evidence: USA Act (S.1581/H.R.3186, $10,000 limit) not enacted. Adjacent but different vehicle: Trump Accounts for minors (P.L. 119-21).

Ask: Cut capital gains taxes or index gains for inflation
Evidence: Not enacted as of Aug 2026. Cruz's Capital Gains Inflation Relief Act pending; Treasury reportedly weighing unilateral indexing (legal risk).

Ask: End green-energy subsidies; change tax treatment of capital investment and R&D
Evidence: P.L. 119-21 terminated most IRA clean-energy credits (end dates from 2025-09-30 through 2027). Capital-investment/R&D tax treatment half of the ask not checked.

Ask: Categorically exclude infill housing from NEPA EIS; reduce federal permitting requirements
Evidence: 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act (P.L. 119-101) became law without signature on 2026-07-11. Sec. 206 requires HUD to create NEPA categorical exclusions including infill housing. (Primary summary re-checked.)

Ask: Condition CDBG/HOME and other funds on land-use reforms (menu of 3+ reforms, parcel inventory, permit shot-clocks, benchmarks)
Evidence: ROAD Act Sec. 213 adjusts CDBG formula by housing-growth metrics (10% cut below median, bonuses at/above), effective third full fiscal year after enactment. No menu-of-reforms or shot-clock condition found.

Ask: Bright-line employee vs independent-contractor test (21st Century Worker Act)
Evidence: DOL proposed (not final) rule on 2026-02-26 rescinding the 2024 contractor rule and reviving the 2021 two-core-factor test; comment period closed 4/28. Sen. Lee's 21st Century Worker Act (S.4010) introduced Mar 2026; no floor action found.

Ask: End government monopoly on registered apprenticeships (Apprenticeship Freedom Act; Training America's Workforce Act)
Evidence: DOL apprenticeship guidance (2026-03-09): competency-based completion and a 30-day registration shot clock, keeping the registered system. No Apprenticeship Freedom Act or Training America's Workforce Act enactment found.

Ask: Review and eliminate needless occupational licensure
Evidence: State universal license recognition spread (about 28 states per a 2025-08 report). No federal action or 2026 enactments found; credit is mostly pre-report baseline.

Ask: Working Families Flexibility Act (paid family leave via comp time)
Evidence: H.R.2870 (Working Families Flexibility Act of 2025) cleared the House Education & Workforce Committee 2025-11-20. No floor passage or Senate action found.

Ask: Employee Rights Act (workers' voice and flexible work)
Evidence: Employee Rights Act (H.R.4154) introduced 2025; no committee or floor action found (absence-of-evidence).

Ask: Eliminate Grad PLUS and Parent PLUS loans; scale back federal student loans; wind down Dept. of Education
Evidence: P.L. 119-21 eliminated Grad PLUS for new borrowers and capped Parent PLUS ($20K/yr, $65K per student), effective 2026-07-01. Dept. of Education wind-down partial (interagency agreements; litigation ongoing); department not abolished.

Ask: Revisit Griggs v. Duke Power (1971) disparate-impact holding
Evidence: Supreme Court has not revisited Griggs. Executive branch acted: EO 14281 (Apr 2025) deprioritized disparate impact; DOJ Dec 2025 final rule removed Title VI disparate-impact regulations.

Ask: Retire bachelor's degree as hiring filter; states stop requiring BAs for public-sector jobs
Evidence: 20+ states removed or reviewed BA requirements for state jobs (as of May 2024). Private-sector retreat not assessed. Baseline predates the report.

Ask: Campus culture friendlier to marriage/family (premarital counseling, married housing, etc.)
Evidence: No campus initiative tied to the report found; only generic existing programs.

Ask: School-day phone bans
Evidence: About 26 states mandate bell-to-bell school phone bans as of 2026 (others partial); mostly enacted 2025-26. No federal action. State count differs by tracker.

Ask: Strict age verification for online pornography
Evidence: Free Speech Coalition v. Paxton (2025-06-27) upheld Texas age verification; about 27 states require it for adult sites. Federal SCREEN Act passed House within the KIDS Act package (2026-06); Senate pending. State laws mostly predate SR323.

Ask: Kids Online Safety Act (platform design-feature requirements)
Evidence: House passed H.R. 7757 (KIDS Act, includes a KOSA version without duty of care) on 2026-06-29. Sen. Blumenthal called it 'dead' in the Senate; Senate KOSA (S. 1748) pending. Not enacted. (Primary summary re-checked.)

Ask: Raise minimum age for social media and certain AI chatbots from 13 to 16 with real age verification
Evidence: No federal minimum age of 16 enacted. Senate passed COPPA 2.0 (protections to age 16) 2026-03-05; House KIDS Act addresses chatbots/age verification. Neither is law. State chatbot laws exist (e.g., CA SB 243).

Ask: App Store Accountability Act (age ratings and parental consent for minors)
Evidence: Federal App Store Accountability Act cleared House E&C 2026-03-04, not law. Texas state law took effect after Fifth Circuit stayed its injunction (2026-06-10); SCOTUS declined to block it 2026-07-06. Utah and Louisiana have similar laws.

Ask: Consolidate ~25 rural broadband programs ($41.032B) under one umbrella open to satellite; reverse auctions; clawbacks
Evidence: NTIA BEAD Restructuring Policy Notice (2025-06-06) went tech-neutral and opened funding to LEO satellite. On 2026-09-04 NTIA let states redeploy about $21B of remaining BEAD funds. No statutory consolidation of the 25+ programs found.

Ask: Statutory 'right to digital homesteading' (limit on government caps on private compute)
Evidence: No federal right-to-compute law. Montana enacted a Right to Compute Act in April 2025; NH HB 1124 passed the House but went to interim study (2026-05-14). Other state bills pending.

Ask: Restorative reproductive medicine: revise infertility coding/reimbursement; allow Title X funds for RRM/fertility awareness; prioritize NIH research on infertility causes
Evidence: HHS posted Title X guidance (April 2026) shifting focus toward natural family planning and fertility awareness; clinics reapplying for Jan 2027. No NIH infertility initiative or coding/reimbursement change found. RESTORE Act (H.R. 3589) not enacted.

Ask: IVF: lower costs without insurance mandates; press pharma on fertility-drug pricing (report endorses existing actions)
Evidence: Feb 2025 IVF EO, then 2025-10-16 EMD Serono deal (discounts up to 84% via TrumpRx), employer standalone fertility-benefit guidance, TrumpRx.gov launch (2026-02), and a tri-agency proposed rule (2026-05). The report endorses existing actions.

Ask: Prioritize drug enforcement; oppose decriminalization; faster controlled-substance scheduling; further restrict vaping
Evidence: Mixed. HALT Fentanyl Act (July 2025) permanent class scheduling matches the scheduling ask. Opposite on marijuana: EO 14370 (Dec 2025) and a DEA rule (2026-04-22) moved medical marijuana to Schedule III. FDA authorized first fruit-flavored vapes (2026-05-06), contrary to restricting vaping.

Ask: Robust conscience protections, religious exemptions, equal treatment of faith-based institutions
Evidence: EO 14202 (2025-02-12) created the Anti-Christian Bias Task Force; Religious Liberty Commission created 2025-05-01; Task Force report 2026-04-30 covers conscience rights and exemptions. The EOs predate SR323.

Ask: Weigh costs and benefits of CO2 emissions; resist 'alarmism' (climate asks)
Evidence: EO 14154 (Jan 2025) disbanded the social-cost-of-greenhouse-gases group. EPA finalized repeal of the 2009 endangerment finding 2026-02-12 (litigation announced/pending). Goes beyond a cost-benefit weighing. (Primary summary re-checked.)

Ask: Default 50-50 shared custody (KY 2018 model; AR Act 604 of 2021)
Evidence: Stateline (Sep 2026) counts 7 states with a 50-50 presumption (KY, AR, WV, FL, MO, MS, LA). 2026 enactments: MS HB 1662 (effective 2026-07-01), LA HB 1239 (effective 2026-08-01). Counts differ by source.

Ask: Modernize alimony statutes (duration caps, lump sums, terminate on remarriage)
Evidence: Florida's 2023 law (HB 1301) ended permanent alimony and capped durational alimony. No 2025-2026 enactment verified; SC bills stayed in committee.

Ask: Offer covenant marriage as an option
Evidence: Covenant marriage still only in AZ, AR, LA. TN HB 315 taken off notice 2026-04-01; MO and TX bills pending/filed; OK SB 228 failed. No 2025-2026 additions found.

Ask: Public scorecards for family-court judges
Evidence: No family-court judge scorecard law or program found; existing judicial evaluations are general reviews.

Ask: Marital-milestone recognition with private award
Evidence: No governor or donor marital-milestone recognition program found.

Ask: Restore blue laws / community day-of-rest laws
Evidence: No new Sunday/day-of-rest enactments found in 2026. Existing blue-law remnants are pre-2026 baseline.

Ask: Lead a revival through family ministries and premarital classes
Evidence: Untrackable: church family-ministry programs are decentralized; no denomination-wide initiative tied to SR323 found.

Ask: Recognize natural family as pre-political reality
Evidence: No federal statement found recognizing the natural family as pre-political. Nearest item ('Fostering the Future' foster-care EO) has no such statement. Normative principle; weak trackability.

Ask: Avoid policies that undermine marriage or reward delay (regulation, welfare, tax, education, housing, tech, environment)
Evidence: No federal action found framed as avoiding measures that undermine marriage or reward delay. Related: Trump Accounts and CTC provisions; assessments conflict (AEI critical).

Ask: Favor natural marriage over same-sex and polyamorous relationships, cohabitation, intentional single parenthood
Evidence: No federal action found favoring natural marriage over other arrangements. Context: Supreme Court denied the Kim Davis petition to revisit Obergefell (2025-11-10; per search results, page not opened).

Ask: Preserve the sex distinction in law against 'gender identity' concepts
Evidence: EO 14168 (2025-01-20) defines sex as male/female and excludes gender identity; SCOTUS allowed passport sex-at-birth policy (Nov 2025) and upheld WV/ID sports bans (2026-06-30). Main federal action predates SR323.

Ask: Protect life from fertilization incl. reproductive technologies and research
Evidence: HHS/NIH ended funding for research using fetal tissue from elective abortions (2026-01-23); matches only the research element. No federal action protecting embryos or restricting IVF; federal IVF actions expand access.

Ask: Preserve parental rights over care, education and upbringing
Evidence: EO 14190 (2025-01-29) directs agencies to protect parents' rights to school information; H.R. 2616 (Stopping Indoctrination and Protecting Kids Act) passed the House 217-198 on 2026-06-24 (Senate action not found).
